execution.owner: Parent serial queue only, after G1 bounded-log gate
execution.reference: Separate untouched original canonical/write_scientific functions and freshly constructed independent fixture objects
execution.resource_caps: Parent plan: <=180 s per scientific command, sampled 1 GiB, total initial 600 s / round 2400 s including failures; no retry or timing reroll
execution.finite_counts_note: 128 cases maximum per mode; exact enumerated count must be frozen in admitted controls before execution. No combinatorial cross product.

retained_costs: All original scientific computation, assertions, runtime/native freshness checks and call coverage
All original eager witness object/list construction, including basis item snapshots and pieces
Every ordered witness/rank record and all canonical bytes; original rank length and distinct-row set calculation
Result encoding, all actual Python decimal/Unicode/nested conversions and configured integer digit-limit enforcement
Three complete artifact hashes and exact EXPECTED dictionary rejection
Final result/witness/rank writes in original order and their successful close
Typed full return, CLI certificate/stdout, ordered complement transcript, before/after source custody and original controls
new_costs: Factory and actual json runtime/source binding checks, helper import and per-invocation fresh admission
Repeated per-record upper-bound calculation during batching if no retained plan
Bounded exact list slices, batch dictionaries/encoder objects, punctuation, Unicode buffers, ASCII byte copies and memoryviews
Incremental hashlib updates for every produced fragment; digest state and byte counters
Unique private stage creation and all staging writes, flushes/closes and disk capacity
Bounded staged reads and final writes; no cached artifact substitutes for fresh serialization
Short-write/error accounting, final close, successful stage unlink/rmdir, failed-stage manifests and cleanup exceptions
Every finite/negative control, independent source review, full original/candidate replay and measurement
Any final-file readback/hash equality checks explicitly added by parent; count separately rather than hiding as output-free validation
Fallback admission overhead plus complete original encoder/write costs for unsupported cases

full_io_bill.note: These counts are arithmetic from historical exact sizes, conditional on identical future outputs. Allocation/RSS, wall/CPU, filesystem cache, syscall counts and cleanup costs are unmeasured.

controls.case: Empty/singleton and ordinary known-schema artifacts
controls.assert: Exact original bytes, all digest/size/count receipt fields and final filenames

controls.case: Non-sorted input dict insertion with exact string keys; ordered source/output/basis list pairs
controls.assert: Only dictionary keys sort; all list/tuple event order remains original

controls.case: 0, -1, positive/negative integers around 2^53 and 2^64, 2300-bit and 20000-bit values under explicitly restored digit settings
controls.assert: No precision loss or fixed-word truncation; byte-for-byte original decimal output or same original exception

controls.case: ASCII quote/backslash/control characters, BMP, astral characters and isolated surrogates
controls.assert: ensure_ascii exact escapes, compact separators and no trailing newline

controls.case: None, booleans, exact finite floats, negative zero, NaN and signed infinities in schema-compatible test leaves
controls.assert: Original type distinctions and literal JSON tokens; no normalization

controls.case: Array lengths 0, 1, 1023, 1024, 1025 and 2048 with total fixture cap
controls.assert: No extra/missing commas/brackets, duplicate records or dropped last record

controls.case: Byte-bound partition immediately below, equal to and above batch upper bound; oversized one-record fallback
controls.assert: Batch bounds honored, whole-record order preserved; fallback output/error equal to original

controls.case: Repeated immutable rank row references versus separately equal rows
controls.assert: Every rank call retained; same rank length/distinct count, bytes and caller references

controls.case: Exact list/tuple nesting at depth boundary and one deeper; circular list and circular dict
controls.assert: Literal fallback before file action; original recursion/circular error type/message preserved

controls.case: dict/list/tuple/int/str/float subclasses with observing or raising hooks, nested in each major artifact position
controls.assert: No callbacks during candidate preflight; original callback count/order and exception from separately reconstructed input

controls.case: Unknown objects, mixed incomparable dictionary keys, supported non-string keys and missing/unexpected schema keys
controls.assert: Literal fallback; original unsupported/sort behavior and successful non-string-key behavior preserved

controls.case: Integer decimal-digit boundary and one beyond configured limit; restore setting in finally
controls.assert: Same original ValueError type/message, no ordinary final files on conversion failure

controls.case: Failed result encoding, failed witness encoding, failed rank encoding independently
controls.assert: No final files before all encodings/counts/expected checks pass; retain staged successful prefixes

controls.case: Wrong expected result/witness/rank digest independently, wrong rank count and wrong distinct count
controls.assert: Original rejection message and no final-file modifications

controls.case: Injected hashing update failure at first/middle/final fragment
controls.assert: Error escapes, produced/persisted prefix accounting explicit, no accepted receipt and no finals

controls.case: Stage directory creation/open/write/flush/close failures at bounded checkpoints
controls.assert: Primary error preserved, descriptors closed, partial staging evidence retained, no finals

controls.case: Final open/write/flush/close failure in result, witness and rank independently
controls.assert: Original final publication order; earlier completed finals preserved, failing prefix retained, later names untouched

controls.case: Controlled short-positive and zero final writes, and byte-budget ENOSPC-style failure
controls.assert: Explicit admitted short-write policy; compare original observable failure/result behavior; disclose syscall-prefix differences

controls.case: Staged read error or staged content mutation between generation and copy
controls.assert: No silent success; exact final readback or before-copy integrity requirement receives parent review; retain affected evidence

controls.case: Cleanup unlink/rmdir and failure-manifest write failure
controls.assert: No earlier-run cleanup; primary exception not masked; visible residual path/secondary failure retained

controls.case: Successful stage lifecycle with all final files closed
controls.assert: Exact final bytes and original receipt; no orphan successful temporary stage

controls.case: Existing parent run output plus direct-call preexisting final files
controls.assert: Parent refuses earlier run overwrite before helper; direct-call wb behavior preserved; expected rejection leaves old bytes unchanged

controls.case: Original canonical/json encoder/helper binding replacement between factory capture and writer invocation
controls.assert: Source-bound rejection before output, no stale admitted PASS or accidental Python-path silent substitution

controls.case: Compare all fixture containers and reference identities before/after writer; repeat invocation on independently changed supported input
controls.assert: No input mutation, hidden persistent answer cache or stale digest reuse

controls.case: Parent runs complete unchanged reference and admitted candidate in distinct processes
controls.assert: Exact 58143622B witness and 2674272B rank artifacts, all expected hashes, typed return, stdout, certificate, 59959 ranks, 252 distinct matrices and original complement coverage

controls.case: Predeclared same-session old/new full protocol after complete control union
controls.assert: Outer wall/CPU/peak RSS and all cold costs recorded; preserve every sample/failure; do not infer from batch size alone

controls.case: Normal/-O finite controls plus full original assertion-on invocation in combined stage
controls.assert: Actual serializer consumer, all helper/runtime identities sealed before execution, before/after source custody exact

unresolved_before_implementation: Reviewer/parent must approve bounded final copy semantics and decide exact short-write behavior; original Path.write_bytes is one buffered write and ignores its return count at caller
Stage tampering checks must be concrete: private process-owned files and same descriptors are baseline assumption; any independent readback/hash is an added full cost, never silently omitted
Actual runtime _json binary and callable authentication belongs to parent closure; upstream source commit alone is not runtime identity
Finite control exact case enumeration and bounded admission metadata must be frozen with implementation
